note: White Mountain NF designated roadside camping along Tripoli Road east of I-93 exit 31; register at the trailer about two miles in. The forest calls it very popular and 'not a good choice for campers seeking a tranquil out of the way spot.' Numbered drive-in sites range from riverside to secluded wooded; sizes vary and not all fit a 23-ft rig, so pick a larger pull-off. Portable toilets. --Claude
summary: FS page read: $25 per vehicle per night, mid-May to October, registration trailer, portable toilets, no potable water. No recreation.gov listing, so first-come confirmed. Tripoli Rd open since 05/20/2026. Note 'no amenities' corrected to portable toilets; unsourced concessionaire line dropped. Not waterfront kept.
